accent.relation: Leaf Green is the brand kit base colour and the centre of the logo leaf; the gradient is the same green lit from lime to teal

ai.mark: sparkle (mdiShimmer) on a solid indigo tile; badge reads AI, owner-written text reads Yours

allowed: the loading mark and the navigation line
the frame around an empty-state or completion icon
the filled end of a progress bar that has finished
gradient.name: Leaf Light
never: button, chip, badge or toggle fills
anything that touches or overlaps a photograph or video
gradient.source: design/frameleaf/brand-kit/frameleaf-symbol.svg #frame-gradient: the five stops and the 137 degree axis of the logo frame

roles.accent: the one primary action of a surface, selection and focus; success uses the same green
roles.ai: reserved for AI-produced content, always with the sparkle
roles.ai-ink: AI labels and links as text; the tile itself stays solid indigo
roles.border-strong: the outline of a control whose edge is its only affordance (3:1)
roles.muted: secondary text; never on frosted material
roles.on-material: secondary text and accent marks on frosted material; the dark accent mark is the brand lime
roles.raised: controls, hover fills, wells inside a panel
roles.viewer: the media viewer, neutral and dark in both themes; its focus ring is the brand lime
roles.warning: needs attention, nothing is lost yet

roles.3: floating capsules: selection bar, status bar

extends: design/frameleaf/tokens.json is a byte-for-byte copy of this file (tokens.spec.ts); edit here, copy there, then regenerate the brand asset inventory

font.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif

iconography.optical: 2px stroke on the 24px grid; six sizes, never scaled between them
iconography.selected: the filled variant marks the current or selected item
iconography.set: Material Design Icons, outline variants at rest

lime.role: light on glass: accent marks on frosted material and the focus ring on the always-dark viewer
lime.source: the highlight edge of the app icon tile (frameleaf-app-icon.svg #tile-edge)

logo.loadingMark: the gradient symbol, 64px, still; it unfurls once and never spins

surfaces.light: gradient symbol plus the name set in text

material.fallback: solid panel under prefers-contrast: more or prefers-reduced-transparency

patterns.dock: fade 200ms plus rise 12px on the 420ms spring; exit 200ms; selection bar, status bar, toasts, inspectors
patterns.hero: view transition on the 520ms spring with a 300ms root crossfade; tile to viewer, cover to album, card to page (data-fl-shared)
patterns.pop: fade 150ms plus scale 0.9 to 1 on the 320ms spring from the anchor corner; exit fades 120ms; menus, popovers, comboboxes
patterns.press: scale 0.96 in 90ms, settle on the spring; buttons and tiles
patterns.reflow: FLIP on the 420ms spring, at most 120 tiles; grid zoom, layout change, reorder
patterns.reveal: fade 180ms on the ease curve, optional 30ms stagger for up to 8 items; skeleton to content, section entry
patterns.sheet: fade 200ms plus rise 40px and scale 0.96 to 1 on the 480ms spring; exit 180ms snappy; dialogs, palettes, phone sheets

signature.name: Unfurl
signature.origin: bottom inline-start, where the leaf meets the frame
use: the logo mark on sign-in, first run and the loading screen
the done mark when a long task completes
the icon of an empty state

motion.spring: linear() spring with slight settle; see tokens.css --fl-spring

numerals.rule: anything that counts, times or aligns in a column uses tabular figures

radius.rule: a control corner is 27% of its height, the ratio of the logo frame: 12px at 44px, 9px at the 34px compact height

scrim.fallback: rgb(0 0 0 / 67%), no blur, under prefers-contrast: more or prefers-reduced-transparency

surface.rule: chrome carries the brand ink, the stage behind photographs stays near neutral, the viewer is neutral

never: Immich, fork, upstream, pipeline, job queue, asset, endpoint, sync token
exclamation marks, please, sorry, oops, successfully
blame: invalid, illegal, failed to (say what to do instead)
principles: Plain: everyday words, no system names
Short: one idea per sentence, the action first
Reassuring: say what is safe before what went wrong
Specific: name the thing and the next step
